brief.note: Alignment Healthcare halved in a fortnight and joins; Fluence aged out, Endeavour Silver fell further.

candidates.name: Alignment Healthcare, Inc.
candidates.business: Runs Medicare Advantage health plans for seniors across several US states
candidates.cause: Flagged $10-11m of unplanned second-half spending and worsening medical costs from hospital billing disputes at an investor conference, without changing guidance; law firms opened investigations.
candidates.right: Medical cost trend settles and the extra second-half spending stays a one-year drag
candidates.wrong: Utilisation keeps climbing, margins compress and the unchanged guidance has to be cut

candidates.name: Endeavour Silver Corp.
candidates.business: Mines silver and gold in Mexico, Peru and Chile
candidates.cause: Took the main ball mill at its Guanacevi mine offline on 21 September for a three-week trunnion replacement, cutting throughput from 1,100 to 600 tonnes daily.
candidates.right: The mill repair finishes on schedule and Guanacevi throughput returns by mid-October
candidates.wrong: The trunnion damage proves deeper, the outage drags on and guidance is cut
